_comment: One fully worked planner beat. scripts/gemini-visual-plan.js embeds this file in the planner prompt (the model cannot open files). The planner describes the scene AND names the beat's type, composition, shot and ground (visual_type, canvas_composition, shot, ground); scripts/scene-translate.js builds the candidates for what it named and the grounding gate checks them against the sentence. The shot is THIS beat's frame division from the reference's grammar (docs/REFERENCE-SHOT-GRAMMAR.md) — on a photo or object shot the shot is the arrangement, so no layout is given; a FIGURE or STATEMENT beat may add a layout. A field left out falls back: no visual_type -> the description decides; no ground -> the house white.
sentence: The real question is whether you need it.

beat.headline: Need it — or want it?
beat.scene_description: The words NEED IT — OR WANT IT? fill the frame in heavy serif, centred, with a thick accent bar below. No photo, no chart — the type IS the visual. Each word pops on its spoken beat.

typography_direction.why: The hook lands the video's central tension in one spoken line.
